label: Safety: nothing bad happens
subgoals: Ask whether a violation is visible after a finite prefix
Classify bounded-response and invariant properties as safety

label: Liveness: something good eventually happens
subgoals: Ask whether any finite prefix could still be completed into a good run
Classify eventually and infinitely-often properties as liveness
Expect a lasso counterexample: prefix plus a loop without the good event

label: Fairness and checking liveness
subgoals: Add fairness constraints that exclude unrealistic environment runs
Check liveness with a fair-cycle search, loop-detecting BMC or liveness-to-safety
Weigh the trade-off of replacing liveness by bounded response
